scope: Exact arithmetic branch specification for the manuscript results labeled thm:an, thm:psl2, thm:nograph, thm:twisted2, thm:twisted1, and thm:graph; published group, subgroup, Levi, and outer-automorphism formulas are named source assumptions, while the deductions from those assumptions are checked mechanically.
affine_convention: [a,b] denotes (a*n+b)*f; for fixed-rank branches n is the displayed fixed rank. Each selected_factor_bound_sets record is the source-derived complete upper-bound list for the p-exponents of factors p^j-1 in that named subgroup's p'-order; constants record remaining integer factors. A q^m+1 factor is represented by doubled p-exponent 2*m*f unless it is named under special_avoidance.

special_avoidance: if r|q+1 then r does not divide q^2+1 because their common divisor divides 2 and r>2
if r|q^3-1 then r does not divide q^3+1 because their common divisor divides 2 and r>2

finite_exception_anchors.terminal: Sp43^k EXCLUDED FOR ALL k >= 2 AND ALL X.
O(7,2)^k EXCLUDED FOR ALL k >= 2 AND ALL X.
